Sartar.name: Sartar
Sartar.notes: Mountainous kingdom of storm worshippers and hardy freedom-fighters.

Esrolia.name: Esrolia
Esrolia.notes: Rich matriarchal land ruled by the Queens of Nochet and Priestesses of Ernalda.

Grazelands.name: Grazelands
Grazelands.notes: Proud nomad horse breeders ruled by the Feathered Horse Queen.

Prax (Bison Rider).name: Prax (Bison Rider)
Prax (Bison Rider).notes: Massive pastoral nomads mounted upon great beasts of the plains.

Prax (High Llama Rider).name: Prax (High Llama Rider)
Prax (High Llama Rider).notes: Tall, dignified nomads riding towering high llamas across the Chaparral.

Prax (Impala Rider).name: Prax (Impala Rider)
Prax (Impala Rider).notes: Nimble, numerous pygmies of Prax deadly with missile bows.

Prax (Pol-Joni).name: Prax (Pol-Joni)
Prax (Pol-Joni).notes: The horse-riding Bastard Tribe of Prax, Heortling outcasts sworn to Storm Bull and Orlanth.

Prax (Sable Rider).name: Prax (Sable Rider)
Prax (Sable Rider).notes: Antelope riders who allied with the Lunar Empire during the conquest of Prax.

Lunar Tarsh.name: Lunar Tarsh
Lunar Tarsh.notes: Civilized, imperial province of the Lunar Empire worshipping the Red Goddess and Hon-Eel.

Old Tarsh.name: Old Tarsh
Old Tarsh.notes: Traditionalist mountain Heortlings around Kero Fin holding to the Earthshaker and ancient ways.

Assistant Shaman.name: Assistant Shaman
Assistant Shaman.magic: Can know 2 spirit magic spells from the shaman (e.g., Spirit Screen 1, Second Sight 1)
Assistant Shaman.description: An apprentice to a tribal or cult shaman, walking between the physical and spiritual worlds.

Bandit.name: Bandit
Bandit.description: Outlaws, bandits, and highway robbers living on the edges of society and preying on travelers.

Chariot Driver.name: Chariot Driver
Chariot Driver.description: Skilled chariot pilots who bear nobles, priests, and champions into glorious combat.

Crafter.name: Crafter
Crafter.description: Blacksmiths, potters, weavers, and masons who fashion the essential tools of Gloranthan civilization.

Entertainer.name: Entertainer
Entertainer.description: Bards, dancers, storytellers, and actors preserving mythic tales and entertaining kings and commoners.

Farmer.name: Farmer
Farmer.description: The proud backbone of Gloranthan society, freeholders who work the fertile soil.

Fisher.name: Fisher
Fisher.description: River and lake boatmen, fisherfolk who harvest the bounty of Engizi, the Creek, and the Mirrorsea.

Healer.name: Healer
Healer.description: Dedicated healers and herbalists vowed to alleviate suffering and cure wounds and plagues.

Herder.name: Herder
Herder.description: Cattle-drivers, sheep-herders, and beast-masters wandering the hills and grazing lands.

Hunter.name: Hunter
Hunter.description: Scouts, trappers, and bowmen attuned to the wild beasts and deep forests of Dragon Pass.

Merchant.name: Merchant
Merchant.description: Caravan masters and market traders who walk the dangerous roads with Issaries’ golden tongue.

Noble.name: Noble
Noble.description: Chieftains, thanes, and aristocrats blessed by bloodline, charisma, and ancestral wealth.

Philosopher.name: Philosopher
Philosopher.description: Seekers of cosmic truth, logicians, and teachers of the Golden Age and God Learner principles.

Priest.name: Priest
Priest.description: Spiritual leaders and custodians of divine mysteries who maintain the rites of the gods.

Scribe.name: Scribe
Scribe.description: Scholars, record-keepers, and archivists literate in arcane scrolls and tax registries.

Thief.name: Thief
Thief.description: Pickpockets, roof-runners, and smugglers thriving in the shadows of Gloranthan cities.

Warrior (Heavy Infantry).name: Warrior (Heavy Infantry)
Warrior (Heavy Infantry).armor: Heavy scale hauberk (5 pts) or disk plate cuirass (5 pts), greaves (6 pts), closed helm (5 pts)
Warrior (Heavy Infantry).description: Armored shock infantry forming stalwart shield walls and phalanxes.

Warrior (Light Infantry).name: Warrior (Light Infantry)
Warrior (Light Infantry).armor: Linothorax (3 pts), cuirboilli greaves (3 pts), composite helm (3 pts)
Warrior (Light Infantry).description: Agile skirmishers and missile specialists screening the vanguard.

Warrior (Heavy Cavalry).name: Warrior (Heavy Cavalry)
Warrior (Heavy Cavalry).armor: Heavy scale hauberk (5 pts), greaves & vambraces (6 pts), closed helm (5 pts), mount
Warrior (Heavy Cavalry).description: Mighty mounted knights and beast-riders breaking enemy lines with lances and heavy blades.

Warrior (Light Cavalry).name: Warrior (Light Cavalry)
Warrior (Light Cavalry).armor: Linothorax (3 pts), cuirboilli greaves (3 pts), open helm (4 pts), mount
Warrior (Light Cavalry).description: Mobile mounted scouts and horse archers harrying enemy flanks.

Argan Argar.name: Argan Argar
Argan Argar.title: God of Surface Darkness
Argan Argar.description: The friendly darkness, god of night-trade between trolls and humans.

Babeester Gor.name: Babeester Gor
Babeester Gor.title: The Avenging Daughter
Babeester Gor.description: Fierce protector of the Earth temples who hunts defilers and oathbreakers.

Chalana Arroy.name: Chalana Arroy
Chalana Arroy.title: Goddess of Healing
Chalana Arroy.description: Pure pacifist goddess of mercy and complete healing.

Daka Fal.name: Daka Fal
Daka Fal.title: Ancestor Worship & Judge of the Dead
Daka Fal.description: The father of mortals who taught humans their ancestors and place in the world.

Eiritha.name: Eiritha
Eiritha.title: Herd Mother
Eiritha.description: Mother of all cattle and herd animals revered across Prax.

Engizi.name: Engizi
Engizi.title: Sky River Titan
Engizi.description: The mighty spirit of the Creek-Stream River flowing from the Sky world.

Ernalda.name: Ernalda
Ernalda.title: Earth Queen
Ernalda.description: Great Queen of the Earth, source of life, fertility, and peace.

Eurmal.name: Eurmal
Eurmal.title: The Trickster & Clown
Eurmal.description: The sacred fool who broke the cosmic laws and introduced death, laughter, and chaos.

Foundchild.name: Foundchild
Foundchild.title: Hunting God
Foundchild.description: The quiet hunter who taught humanity how to live off the land without offending the wild.

Humakt.name: Humakt
Humakt.title: God of Death and War
Humakt.description: The austere god of honorable martial prowess who severed ties to his kin to embody Death.

Issaries.name: Issaries
Issaries.title: God of Communication and Trade
Issaries.description: The golden-tongued herald and merchant protecting travelers across dangerous borders.

Lhankor Mhy.name: Lhankor Mhy
Lhankor Mhy.title: Lord of Knowledge
Lhankor Mhy.description: The bearded god of scholars, law, writing, and esoteric secrets.

Maran Gor.name: Maran Gor
Maran Gor.title: The Earthshaker
Maran Gor.description: Terrifying goddess of dinosaurs, earthquakes, and merciless fury.

Odayla.name: Odayla
Odayla.title: The Bear God
Odayla.description: Son of Orlanth and hunter who wrested power from the Great Bear.

Orlanth.name: Orlanth
Orlanth.title: King of the Gods, Storm & Freedom
Orlanth.description: The rebel storm king who slew the Sun, brought death, and led the Lightbringers to restore the cosmos.

Seven Mothers.name: Seven Mothers
Seven Mothers.title: Recreators of the Red Goddess
Seven Mothers.description: The missionary cult of the Lunar Empire offering inclusion, redemption, and lunar illumination.

Storm Bull.name: Storm Bull
Storm Bull.title: The Chaos Killer (Urox)
Storm Bull.description: The berserk desert storm god who pinned Wakboth the Devil beneath the Block.

Waha.name: Waha
Waha.title: The Butcher & Founder of Prax
Waha.description: Hero-god who instituted the Survival Covenant and taught Praxians to cast lots between eaters and eaten.

Yelm.name: Yelm
Yelm.title: The Sun Emperor
Yelm.description: Sovereign Lord of the Sky and Cosmic Order.

Yelmalio.name: Yelmalio
Yelmalio.title: Sun God of the Frontier
Yelmalio.description: The unyielding Light that survived the Darkness when the Sun fell into the Underworld.

Yinkin.name: Yinkin
Yinkin.title: The Shadowcat God
Yinkin.description: Brother to Orlanth and patron of shadowcats, hunters, and solitary stealth.

commonRuneSpells.name: Command Cult Spirit
commonRuneSpells.description: Compels an unallied cult spirit or elemental to obey the caster for 15 minutes.

commonRuneSpells.name: Dismiss Magic
commonRuneSpells.description: Dispels 1 point of Rune magic or 2 points of spirit magic per Rune Point spent.

commonRuneSpells.name: Divination
commonRuneSpells.description: Ritual inquiry with the deity on sacred ground regarding a specific question.

commonRuneSpells.name: Extension
commonRuneSpells.description: Extends duration of an accompanied temporal Rune spell (1 pt = 1 hr, 2 pts = 1 day, 3 pts = 1 wk, 4 pts = 1 season, 5 pts = 1 yr).

commonRuneSpells.name: Find Enemy
commonRuneSpells.description: Detects anyone within range intending harm to the caster.

commonRuneSpells.name: Heal Wound
commonRuneSpells.description: Instantly heals 1D6 hit points per Rune Point spent on a wounded hit location.

commonRuneSpells.name: Multispell
commonRuneSpells.description: Allows simultaneous casting of 1 additional spirit magic spell per Rune Point spent.

commonRuneSpells.name: Sanctify
commonRuneSpells.description: Ritually consecrates an area (10m radius per point) as temporary holy ground.

commonRuneSpells.name: Soul Sight
commonRuneSpells.description: Reveals POW, Magic Points, active spells, and Rune affinities of targets in view.

commonRuneSpells.name: Spirit Block
commonRuneSpells.description: Blocks 2D6 points of Spirit Combat damage per Rune Point spent.

commonRuneSpells.name: Summon Cult Spirit
commonRuneSpells.description: Ritually summons a cult spirit or elemental (1 pt = Small, 2 pts = Medium, 3 pts = Large).

commonRuneSpells.name: Warding
commonRuneSpells.description: Ritually protects an area with four stakes; intruders take 1D3 damage per point and trigger a mental alarm.

heirlooms: Ancestor worshiped as hero (+10% Devotion/Loyalty, +5% Orate, +5% Rep)
1D3 pots of Rhino Fat (+1 armor to all hit locations for 1 hr)
Bronze or ceramic votive image (+10% Worship)
Finely made musical instrument (+10% Play Instrument)
Necklace with 2-point Glamour spirit magic matrix
Ancient gold serpent armband with 2-pt matrix
Awakened small animal companion with 3 pts spirit magic
Iron weapon passed down through generations (+2 HP and bypasses parries against non-iron)
Enchanted silver torc protecting against magical attacks (+2 vs spells)
Map of the Elder Wilds showing lost ruins and hidden caves
Scroll written in Old Wyrmish detailing ancient Dragon Pass secrets

familyHistoryEvents.event: Battle of Grizzly Peak: King Tarkalor fell fighting the Lunar Empire.
Starbrow's Rebellion: Defeated heroes fled to the hills or were sacrificed.
Boldhome Falls: The flame of Sartar is extinguished by the Lunar Red Emperor.
Starbrow's Return: Short-lived uprising brutally suppressed.
Great Winter begins: Sun does not rise properly, famine grips Dragon Pass.
Windstop: The Wind dies completely; Sartarites preserve holy rituals.
The Dragonrise! A giant True Dragon awakens beneath the new Lunar Temple, devouring the Lunar army! Freedom is proclaimed!

pregens.name: Vasana Farnan's Daughter
pregens.notes: Vasana is a small but athletic woman with red hair and a terrible scar across the left half of her face. Devoted Vingan cavalry champion.

pregens.name: Yanioth Vareena's Daughter
pregens.notes: Yanioth is a radiant and poised priestess of Ernalda, gifted in diplomacy, family leadership, and deep earth mysteries.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Befuddle
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Confuses and incapacitates a target unless they only parry/dodge.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Binding Enchantment
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Creates a condition to bind a spirit or elemental into an object.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Bladesharp
spiritMagicCatalog.description: +5% attack chance and +1 damage per point on an edged weapon.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Bludgeon
spiritMagicCatalog.description: +5% attack chance and +1 damage per point on a crushing weapon.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Coordination
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Increases DEX by +2 (up to 1.5x original DEX).

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Countermagic
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Shields target against hostile spirit and Rune magic up to its point value.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Darkwall
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Creates an impenetrable wall or globe of darkness (5m radius).

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Demoralize
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Fills target with doubt; halves weapon skills and prevents offensive magic.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Detect Enemies
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Reveals any beings intending harm within 50 meters.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Detect Gems
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Detects precious stones within 50 meters.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Detect Gold
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Detects gold within 50 meters.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Detect Life
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Detects living creatures of a specified type within 50 meters.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Detect Magic
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Reveals enchanted items, active spells, or spirits within 50 meters.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Detect Silver
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Detects silver within 50 meters.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Detect Spirit
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Detects disembodied spirits within 50 meters.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Detect Trap
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Reveals mechanical or magical traps within 50 meters.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Detect Undead
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Detects undead beings within 50 meters.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Dispel Magic
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Eliminates points of active spirit magic (or 2 pts per 1 pt of Rune magic).

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Disruption
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Inflicts 1D3 damage to a random hit location, ignoring armor.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Dullblade
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Reduces weapon attack by -5% and damage by -1 per point.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Extinguish
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Puts out flames (1 pt = torch, 2 pts = campfire, 3 pts = bonfire).

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Fanaticism
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Increases melee weapon attack by +50%, but target cannot parry, dodge, or cast spells.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Farsee
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Halves distance for visual perception per point.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Firearrow
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Missile bursts into flame, dealing 3D6 fire damage instead of normal damage.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Fireblade
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Melee blade turns to fire, dealing 3D6 fire damage (no damage bonus).

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Glamour
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Increases CHA by +2 (up to 1.5x original CHA) and +15% to Communication skills.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Glue
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Creates a sticky patch with STR equal to 5 per point.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Heal
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Heals 1 HP per point to a single hit location (6+ pts reattaches severed limb).

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Ignite
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Sets a flammable object or dry material on fire.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Invisibility
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Renders target transparent; attackers suffer -40% penalty.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Lantern
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Causes an inanimate object to glow with torchlight in a 3m radius.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Light
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Illuminates a 10m radius area around a target point.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Lightwall
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Creates a blinding wall or globe of brilliant light (5m radius).

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Mindspeech
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Allows telepathic communication with 1 intelligent target per point.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Mobility
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Increases target Movement Rate (MOV) by +4.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Multimissile
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Duplicates a thrown/fired missile, adding 1 magic missile per point.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Parry
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Increases parry chance with a weapon or shield by +5% per point.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Protection
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Adds +1 Armor Point (AP) per point to all hit locations.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Repair
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Restores 1D6 Armor Points / HP per point to a damaged inanimate object.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Second Sight
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Allows caster to see POW auras, spirits, and Rune affinities.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Shimmer
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Distorts visual outline, reducing physical attack chances against target by -5% per point.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Silence
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Suppresses sound made by target, adding +20% to Move Quietly.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Sleep
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Puts target into a deep magical slumber until awakened or harmed.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Slow
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Halves target Movement Rate (MOV).

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Speedart
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Adds +15% attack chance and +3 damage to a single missile.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Spirit Binding
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Binds a defeated spirit (at 0 MP) into a prepared binding enchantment.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Spirit Screen
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Reduces spirit combat damage suffered by target by 2 points per point.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Strength
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Increases STR by +3 (up to 1.5x original STR).

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Vigor
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Increases CON by +3 (up to 1.5x original CON) and adjusts HP accordingly.

spiritMagicCatalog.name: Visibility
spiritMagicCatalog.description: Forces a discorporate spirit to become visible to normal sight.

Absorption.description: Absorbs up to 1 point of enemy spell per RP and converts it to Magic Points.

Analyze Magic.description: Identifies all spells, enchantments, and magical properties on an item or person.

Axe Trance.description: Increases 1H/2H Axe skill to 100% (or +20% per RP) while in battle trance.

Axis Mundi.description: Opens a direct passage between the Mundane World and the Spirit World.

Banish Spirit.description: Forces a spirit out of the Mundane World back into the Spirit World.

Bear Fruit.description: Causes a mature plant or tree to immediately blossom and produce edible fruit.

Bear’s Strength.description: Doubles the target’s STR for 15 minutes.

Bearskin.description: Grants +5 natural armor points, +4 CON, and immunity to Countermagic/Dispel Magic.

Beastmaster.description: Commands a wild animal to obey the caster.

Become Other.description: Transforms caster into an exact physical double of another person.

Berserker.description: Doubles CON, +50% melee attack, +2 AP skin, immune to unconsciousness/emotions.

Bind Ghost.description: Binds a ghost to guard a specific place or item.

Blast Earth.description: Explodes a 3m cube of earth or stone, dealing 3D6 damage to all within.

Bless Animals.description: Ritually blesses a herd so females bear healthy offspring and resist disease.

Bless Crops.description: Ritually blesses farmland, adding +20% to Farm rolls per RP.

Bless Hunting Dog.description: Doubles a hound’s Track, Listen, and Scan skills.

Bless Pregnancy.description: Ensures a safe pregnancy and healthy childbirth.

Breathe Air/Water.description: Allows target to breathe underwater (or a water creature to breathe air).

Butcher.description: Doubles Peaceful Cut skill and instantly slaughters and dresses a herd beast.

Call Clouds.description: Summons clouds to cover the sky within 1 km per RP.

Call Wind.description: Increases wind strength by +3D6 per RP or shifts wind direction.

Cancel Spirit Magic.description: Prevents target from casting any Spirit Magic for 15 minutes.

Catseye.description: Allows the target to see clearly in darkness or starlight as if daylight.

Chaos Gift.description: Bestows a random Chaotic feature upon the target for 15 minutes.

Chaos Spawn.description: Summons a lesser creature of Chaos or broo.

Charisma.description: Doubles the caster’s CHA for 15 minutes.

Clairvoyance.description: Views a distant location up to 5 km away.

Claw.description: Transforms hands into bear claws (75% skill, 1D6+1 + DB damage, magical).

Claws.description: Transforms hands into shadowcat claws (75% skill, 1D6 + DB damage, magical).

Clear Path.description: Clears obstacles, brush, and debris from a trail as the caster walks.

Cloud Clear.description: Dispels clouds from the sky over a 1 km radius per RP.

Combine.description: Merges caster’s mind with a shadowcat to perceive through its senses.

Comfort Song.description: Soothes pain and grief, freeing listeners from fear, demoralization, or madness.

Command Beast.description: Compels a herd beast to obey the caster.

Command Dinosaur.description: Compels a dinosaur to obey the caster.

Command Ghost.description: Compels a ghost or ancestor spirit to obey the caster.

Command Horse.description: Compels a horse to obey the caster.

Command Snake.description: Compels a snake or serpent spirit to obey the caster.

Create Fissure.description: Opens a chasm 6m deep and 3m wide in the earth.

Create Market.description: Establishes a sacred neutral marketplace protected by Warding and Issaries’ peace.

Create Shadow.description: Creates a 10m radius area of soothing shade and dim shadow.

Crush.description: Doubles the damage bonus of a blunt/crushing weapon for 15 minutes.

Cure All Disease.description: Immediately cures target of any natural or magical disease.

Cure Chaos Wound.description: Purifies a wound inflicted by Chaos so it can be healed by magic.

Cure Poison.description: Neutralizes any poison or venom in the target’s body and restores lost CON.

Dark Walk.description: Allows target to move silently (+35% Move Quietly/Hide) and see in total darkness.

Detect Truth.description: Caster immediately knows whether a speaker is telling the truth or lying.

Discorporation.description: Separates the caster’s spirit from their physical body to travel in the Spirit World.

Dismiss Air Elemental.description: Banishes an Air Elemental (1 pt = Small, 2 pts = Medium, 3 pts = Large).

Dismiss Darkness Elemental.description: Banishes a Darkness Elemental (1 pt = Small, 2 pts = Medium, 3 pts = Large).

Dismiss Earth Elemental.description: Banishes an Earth Elemental (1 pt = Small, 2 pts = Medium, 3 pts = Large).

Dismiss Elemental.description: Banishes any elemental (1 pt = Small, 2 pts = Medium, 3 pts = Large).

Dismiss Fire Elemental.description: Banishes a Fire Elemental (1 pt = Small, 2 pts = Medium, 3 pts = Large).

Dismiss Lune.description: Banishes a Lune (1 pt = Small, 2 pts = Medium, 3 pts = Large).

Dismiss Water Elemental.description: Banishes a Water Elemental (1 pt = Small, 2 pts = Medium, 3 pts = Large).

Draw Beast.description: Attracts a game animal within 1 km toward the hunter.

Earth Shield.description: Grants +6 armor points and +6 points of Countermagic while touching the ground.

Earthpower.description: Neutralizes all hostile Air and Storm magic within 25 meters.

Earthquake.description: Violently shakes a 50m radius area, collapsing structures and knocking down foes.

Enchant (Animal) Part.description: Ritually enchants a bone, hide, or Sinew from a peacefully cut animal.

Enchant Lead.description: Ritually enchants unworked lead into dark-metal capable of harming spirits.

Face Chaos.description: Grants immunity to Demoralize and Fear when fighting Chaos.

Fear.description: Strikes terror into an enemy, forcing them to flee or surrender.

Fight Disease.description: Adds +25% per RP to the patient’s CON roll to resist disease.

Find Substance.description: Locates a specified mineral, metal, or substance within range.

Fireshield.description: Reduces all fire and heat damage suffered by 2D6 per RP.

Flight.description: Allows target (up to 12 SIZ/ENC per RP) to fly through the air at MOV 12.

Free Ghost.description: Releases a bound ghost and sends it to the Courts of Silence.

Gnaw.description: Rots and weakens wooden or organic items (reducing HP by 2D6).

Hallucinate.description: Traps target in a vivid, all-encompassing sensory illusion.

Harmony.description: Calms all combatants within 20m, ending fighting unless attacked.

Heal Body.description: Completely restores all HP, reattaches limbs, and stops all bleeding.

Heal Mind.description: Cures madness, feeblemindedness, or psychological trauma.

Healing Trance.description: Places patient into deep regenerative sleep that doubles natural healing.

Hibernation.description: Enters a winter sleep requiring no food or water for up to a season.

Identify Scent.description: Grants shadowcat-keen smell (+50% Track by scent).

Illusory Motion.description: Grants movement to an Illusory Sight.

Illusory Odor.description: Creates a realistic phantom smell or taste.

Illusory Sight.description: Creates a visual illusion up to SIZ 20.

Illusory Sound.description: Creates realistic phantom sounds or voices.

Illusory Substance.description: Gives physical solidity and weight to an illusion.

Impede Chaos.description: Prevents a Chaos creature from using Chaotic features or casting magic.

Incarnate Ancestor.description: Summons an ancestor spirit into an artificial body or willing host.

Inviolable.description: Attackers must overcome caster’s POW or be unable to strike the priestess.

Kinship.description: Reveals whether two creatures are related by blood and greets felines as kin.

Knowledge.description: Reveals the history and origin of an object held by the sage.

Leap.description: Allows caster to leap up to 20 meters horizontally or 10 meters vertically.

Lie.description: Makes a spoken falsehood completely believable, fooling even Detect Truth.

Lightning.description: Hurls a bolt of lightning dealing 1D6 electrical damage per RP (ignores armor).

Lock.description: Magically seals a door, chest, or portal (+20 STR to force open).

Madness.description: Afflicts target with lunar lunacy or debilitating phobia.

Mind Read.description: Reads the surface thoughts of a target within range.

Mindblast.description: Shatters target’s mind, halving INT and preventing magic casting for 15 minutes.

Mist Cloud.description: Blankets a 50m radius per RP in thick fog, obscuring vision beyond 1.5m.

Moonburn.description: Burns target with cold crimson moonlight for 2D6 damage ignoring armor.

Morale.description: Grants allies within 25m +25% to weapon skills and immunity to Demoralize/Fear.

Multiply Beasts.description: Ensures twin births for blessed herd animals.

Oath.description: Binds sworn parties to a sacred pact; oathbreakers suffer immediate 6D6 internal damage.

Order.description: Compels a subordinate within the cult hierarchy to obey a lawful command.

Passage.description: Opens a temporary 2m doorway through a solid wall or barrier.

Path Watch.description: Alerts caster to any ambushes, hazards, or pursuit along a road for 1 day.

Peace.description: Prevents violence within the blessed herd or sanctuary.

Rain.description: Causes rain (or snow) to fall from clouds over a 1 km radius.

Read Language.description: Allows the sage to read any written script at 80% skill for 15 minutes.

Reconstruction.description: Visually replays past events that occurred at the caster’s location.

Reflection.description: Reflects hostile spells of up to its RP value back at the original caster.

Regrow Limb.description: Regenerates a severed or maimed limb over 1 week.

Restore Health.description: Restores 1D3 permanently lost characteristic points per RP spent.

Resurrect.description: Returns a recently slain adventurer’s soul from the Underworld to their healed body.

Safe.description: Protects stored goods from theft, spoilage, or vermin.

Sever Spirit.description: Instantly slays target if POW vs POW succeeds (or deals 3D6 HP on failure).

Shadowcat.description: Transforms the initiate into a giant shadowcat for 15 minutes.

Shake Earth.description: Causes localized tremors in a 10m radius, knocking down foes (DEXx3 to stay standing).

Shield.description: Grants +2 Armor Points and +2 Countermagic per RP spent.

Slash.description: Doubles the base weapon damage of a slashing axe or blade.

Smash.description: Doubles the base weapon damage of a crushing weapon or axe against objects/foes.

Speak to Beasts (Shadowcats).description: Allows fluent speech with shadowcats and felines.

Speak to Herd Beasts.description: Allows fluent speech with herd animals.

Spell Trading.description: Allows trading a one-use Rune spell with another initiate.

Spin.description: Spins target helplessly unless they resist; halves attack and parry.

Spirit Guardian.description: Summons a protective ancestor spirit to defend the target in spirit combat.

Spirit Melding.description: Merges an allied spirit with the caster, combining POW and MP.

Splatter.description: Causes a small object or fruit to burst messily.

Strongnet.description: Doubles the HP and STR of a fishing or combat net.

Summon Air Elemental.description: Summons an Air Elemental (1 pt = Small, 2 pts = Medium, 3 pts = Large).

Summon Ancestor.description: Summons a random ancestor spirit from the caster’s lineage.

Summon Bear.description: Summons a wild bear to aid the initiate.

Summon Darkness Elemental.description: Summons a Darkness Elemental (1 pt = Small, 2 pts = Medium, 3 pts = Large).

Summon Dinosaur.description: Summons a dinosaur native to the region.

Summon Earth Elemental.description: Summons an Earth Elemental (1 pt = Small, 2 pts = Medium, 3 pts = Large).

Summon Elemental.description: Summons an elemental of any element (1 pt = Small, 2 pts = Medium).

Summon Fire Elemental.description: Summons a Fire Elemental (1 pt = Small, 2 pts = Medium, 3 pts = Large).

Summon Healing Spirit.description: Summons a cult healing spirit to cure disease or wounds.

Summon Lune.description: Summons a Lune (1 pt = Small, 2 pts = Medium, 3 pts = Large).

Summon Naiad.description: Summons a river nymph spirit of Engizi.

Summon Shadowcat.description: Summons a shadowcat to aid the initiate.

Summon Specific Ancestor.description: Summons a specific named ancestor spirit.

Summon Spirit Teacher.description: Summons a cult teaching spirit to instruct the initiate in spirit magic.

Summon Water Elemental.description: Summons a Water Elemental (1 pt = Small, 2 pts = Medium, 3 pts = Large).

Sunbright.description: Blazes with miniature sunlight (50m radius), blinding Darkness creatures and dispelling shadows.

Sunripen.description: Ripens crops or fruit and dries wet earth.

Sunspear.description: Calls down a pillar of solar fire from the sky dealing 4D6 damage (ignores armor).

Suppress Lodril.description: Quenches fire and suppresses Fire/Sky magic in range.

Sureshot.description: Guides missile weapons so wind and range penalties are ignored (+20% hit).

Swallow.description: Allows the Trickster to swallow an item or creature whole into a belly pocket.

Sword Trance.description: Increases Sword skill to 100% (or +20% per RP) while in battle trance.

Teleport.description: Instantly transports the caster in a flash of wind and thunder to a visible or sanctified spot.

Thunderbolt.description: Strikes a foe with a deafening bolt from the sky dealing 3D6 damage (ignores armor).

Translate.description: Allows the sage to speak and understand any spoken language at 80% for 15 minutes.

True Axe.description: Doubles the base weapon damage of a blessed 1H or 2H Axe.

Truebow.description: Doubles the base weapon damage of a Composite Bow.

Truespeak.description: Compels the target to speak only the literal truth for 15 minutes.

Truespear.description: Doubles the base weapon damage of a 1H Spear, 2H Spear, Pike, or Lance.

Truesword.description: Doubles the base weapon damage of a Broadsword, Shortsword, or Greatsword.

Turn Undead.description: Forces undead creatures to flee or be destroyed in a POW vs POW contest.

Weapon Trance.description: Increases cult weapon skill to 100% (or +20% per RP) while in battle trance.

Wind Warp.description: Commands winds within 100m, grounding flyers and deflecting all normal missiles.

Wind Words.description: Carries whispered words on the wind to a listener up to 5 km away.
